name: Force of Presence
text: Add the rolled total to a Presence roll, or make a single NPC of lesser standing yield a minor concession with no roll. What they yield, they yield in front of witnesses.

name: Read the Table
text: In any negotiation, learn each present NPC's true priority and which of them will break first.

name: Common Ground
text: Bridge a cultural divide instantly; treat a stranger as a known contact for the scene.

name: The Ledger Remembers
text: Add the rolled total to a roll that leverages who owes whom, or surface a true obligation an NPC is bound by. Either way, the obligation becomes established fact; the debt outlives the scene.

name: Leverage
text: Produce a piece of usable leverage on a target you have had time to study. One use.

name: Field Improvisation
text: Choose one: restore personal or vehicle Armor Slots, drone HP, or one ship arc's Armor Slots equal to the total; restore 1 Hull per full 5 points in the total, maximum 3 Hull and once per ship per scene; return one offline Common or Military device to service for the scene; or assemble a single-use device that grants Advantage on one declared Core Trait Roll before the scene ends. It requires suitable scrap but no workshop and never raises a maximum.

name: Hot-Wire
text: Bypass one non-Precursor lock or activate one non-Precursor machine without a Roll until the end of the scene. The device immediately records an unauthorized-access alert detectable by its owner or local security; Hot-Wire grants no credentials and cannot override a safety rule that names a higher requirement.

name: Ghost in the Logs
text: Add the total to one Knowledge Roll for network access or intrusion, or read the system's recorded activity from the previous 24 hours. If the system contains credentials for an established identity, you may attribute the intrusion to that identity; this cannot create a person, credential, or access level that was not already present.

name: Safe Handling
text: Before handling a Precursor artifact, name one hazard printed in its entry. Suppress that hazard for you and willing assistants until the scene ends. This does not suppress costs, Corruption, or any other effect and cannot affect an unidentified hazard.

name: Stabilize
text: Clear HP marks from a downed or wounded ally equal to the rolled total. Field medicine, not magic.

name: Find a Way
text: There is always a route. Discover a viable path through terrain, a blockade, or a sealed approach.

name: Read the Ground
text: Learn the chief hazard and one resource or landmark of unfamiliar terrain before crossing.

name: Perfect Recall of Place
text: In any place you have mapped, add the rolled total to a relevant roll, and you never lose your way.

name: Endure
text: You and the crew ignore one environmental hazard (heat, toxin, an exposure window) for a meaningful stretch.

name: Run It Down
text: When tracking or pursuing, add the rolled total; on a hit, close to your quarry. Your quarry now knows it is hunted.

name: Calibrated Minor Ritual
text:
Spend 10 uninterrupted minutes performing a documented group procedure. Roll the spent Resolve Die. Choose one Minor Ritual effect and a number of willing creatures up to your level + your Spellcast Trait modifier, minimum one. Every target must remain present throughout the procedure and receives the same chosen effect. The ritual lasts a number of hours equal to the Resolve Die result. It does not generate Fear and requires no Spellcast Roll. A creature can benefit from only one of your Calibrated Minor Rituals at a time; a new one replaces the old one.

- Group Calibration. Choose Agility, Strength, Finesse, Knowledge, Instinct, or Presence. Every affected creature gains +1 to Rolls using that Trait. This does not modify damage, healing, Effort, Resolve, derived statistics, or the ritual's target limit.

- Group Adaptation. Choose one specific environmental hazard examined or anticipated during the ritual, such as the radiation in this reactor, the pressure of this submerged facility, or the toxic spores of this organism. Every affected creature has Advantage on Rolls to resist, endure, or recover from that hazard. This does not grant immunity or prevent consequences that allow no resistance roll.

- Sustained Restoration. At the end of every complete hour, every affected creature clears 1 marked HP. This cannot restore the dead, remove Scars, repair Armor Slots, or heal a creature while they are Dying. At any time while an affected creature is Dying, you may consume all remaining ritual duration and end the ritual for everyone to stabilize that creature. Stabilization clears all Dying and Final Progress but restores no HP.

name: Uncanny Power
text:
Choose how many Resolve to spend, then roll one Resolve Die for each Resolve spent and add your Spellcast Trait once. The Keeper immediately gains 1 Fear for each Resolve spent, subject to the hard maximum of 12. The result is the maximum Domain level you can access, capped by your character level. After seeing the result, choose any Power from an unlocked Domain-level package whose level does not exceed that result.

Invoking the Power takes a full Action and permits nothing else that turn. It cannot reproduce a Reaction or Passive Power. Ignore the Power's printed Hope cost and printed Spellcast Trait or DC, but pay any Stress, HP, material, frequency, or other printed cost. Make a Knowledge Spellcast Roll against DC = 10 + the chosen Power's Level, meaning the level of its unlocked Domain package. On success, resolve the Power normally. On failure, it does not manifest; the action and Resolve remain spent, and the Keeper retains all generated Fear.

Critical return. On a Critical Success, the Power manifests and you immediately regain every Resolve spent on this use of Uncanny Power, up to your Resolve maximum. The Keeper retains the Fear already generated, and all non-Resolve costs remain paid.

name: Never Tell Me the Odds
text: When a maneuver is called impossible or the odds are quoted, do it anyway: declare a quirk of this hull that makes it possible (a blind spot, a rattle before the stall, a tolerance the specs missed). The quirk is true and permanent. Roll with Advantage; on a Fear-dominant noncritical Roll, the ship pays, not the crew.

name: Hold Together
text: Reduce the damage your ship takes this round by the rolled total, or keep a failing system online.

name: Lose the Tail
text: When traffic, debris, terrain, or a previously established escape route is present, end one pending Sensor Lock on your ship or mark 1 segment on a visible escape clock. It cannot erase detection or end pursuit in open space without a viable route.

name: Gun Run
text: Add the rolled total to a ship-weapon attack; on a hit, it lands one threshold band higher.

name: Reroute Power
text: This round, push one ship system (engines, weapons, or shields) past its rated limit.

name: Analyze Weakness
text: Study a foe or object and reveal a vulnerability that grants the crew Advantage against it for the scene.

name: I Have Read About This
text: Add the rolled total to any Knowledge roll, and declare one true, useful fact into the scene.

name: Know the Beast
text: Learn a creature's behavior, diet, threat pattern, and one weakness.

name: Dig-Site Discipline
text: Add the rolled total to a roll to safely excavate, date, or disarm a Vault feature. Your markers remain; the next team through follows them safely.

name: Signal in the Noise
text: Extract the true message from corrupted data, propaganda, or a flood of intel.

name: Vanish
text: Break line of sight and leave a tense scene with no roll, to reappear where it will hurt them most.

name: The Long Con
text: Plant a false belief or forged credential that holds up under one round of scrutiny.

name: Killing Window
text: Against an unaware or marked target, add the rolled total to the strike, and it lands one threshold band higher.

name: Never Was Here
text: Erase your presence from a scene after the fact: records, witnesses' certainty, sensor traces.

name: False Bottom
text: Produce a small forbidden item you "had stashed," or hide one from a search.

name: Take the Hit
text: When an ally within Close range is hit, intercept the attack. Reduce the damage by the rolled total and take any remaining damage yourself.

name: Disciplined Strike
text: Add the rolled total to a damage roll. The target cannot spend Armor Slots against the added portion of this damage.

name: Bulwark
text: Grant one ally within Close range Armor Slots equal to the rolled total until the end of the scene. Unspent Armor Slots granted by this Move vanish when the scene ends.

name: Order the Line
text: Choose one ally who can hear you. They immediately move one range band or make one attack outside their Spotlight. This does not consume their Reaction.

name: Stand Down
text: Add the rolled total to a roll made to disarm, restrain, or de-escalate without killing. Word spreads that you ended it without blood.

name: The Weightless Art
text: For the rolled total in rounds, your ki makes the world your floor: walls, water, cables, and the heads of a crowd. You fall without sound or harm, and your leaps cross one additional range band. This is motion, never flight: every step begins and ends on something.

name: Falling Star
text: Close one range band, descending or leaping if the approach allows it, and attack. Add the rolled total to the damage. If you arrived from above, the strike deals your branch's damage type - Void, Kinetic, or Lux - instead of physical, and treats the target's Major and Severe Thresholds as 4 lower for this hit. This penetration replaces and never stacks with the damage type's own penetration effect.

name: Stillness
text: Until your next Spotlight, you cannot be targeted by an attack that requires seeing you. You are simply not where the eye expects.

name: Shockwave
text: Your next Melee hit adds the rolled total to its damage. Then choose one: move the target one range band directly away from you, or apply Prone.

name: Burning Focus
text: Until your next Spotlight, you shed light nothing can hide from. Enemies within Close range cannot benefit from Hidden against you.
